description: This source file provides utility functions for securely extracting ZIP files, creating ZIP archives from directories or files, and listing contents of ZIP archives. It includes safety checks against path traversal and ZipSlip vulnerabilities, and handles file compression and extraction operations.

methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive containing a list of specified files, maintaining relative paths.

methods.description: Returns a list of filenames contained in a ZIP archive.
